channel.title: Problem Sets on MIT OpenCourseWare
channel.description: Recent content in Problem Sets on MIT OpenCourseWare

item.title: Brick Control
item.description: Supporting file for a problem set: a Matlab routine containing the basic framework for implementing the required controllers for a problem on optimal control of the double integrator.

item.title: Brick VI
item.description: Supporting file for a problem set on value iteration on the double integrator. This function implements the value iteration algorithm for the brick.

item.title: Calc Basin
item.description: Supporting file for a problem set: a Matlab routine containing the basic components to compute and plot the basins of attraction for the simple pendulum.

item.title: Cartpole
item.description: Supporting file for a problem set on swing-Up and balance for the cart-pole system

item.title: Cartpole WP
item.description: Supporting file for a problem set: the file contains a (nearly) complete implementation of the weight perturbation algorithm for the cart-pole swing-up task.

item.title: Markov TD
item.description: Supporting file for a problem set on temporal difference learning.

item.title: pendfun.m
item.description: This resource is a supporting file for assignment 3.

item.title: Pendulum SNOPT
item.description: Supporting file for a problem set: a basic Matlab skeleton implementation calling the SNOPT sequential quadratic programming (SQP) package.

item.title: Problem Set 1
item.description: Problem set on the definition of underactuated, the simple pendulum, and optimal control of the double integrator.

item.title: Problem Set 2
item.description: Problem set on value iteration on the double integrator, Pontryagin’s minimum principle, and swing-up and balance for the cart-pole system.

item.title: Problem Set 3
item.description: Problem set on optimal swing-up for the simple pendulum, single-pump swing-up for the cart-pole, and the rimless wheel.

item.title: Problem Set 4
item.description: Problem set on the spring loaded inverted pendulum and motion planning with rapidly-exploring random trees.

item.title: Problem Set 5
item.description: Problem set on the weight-perturbation algorithm and temporal difference learning.

item.title: Slip
item.description: Supporting file for a problem set: the basic Matlab code needed for the simulation of the passive SLIP model.
